**`outputs/runs/single/risk-assessment.html`** (20 KB) — Self-contained interactive internal dashboard with: gross risk score 18.0% → net risk 8.3% after negotiation positions, revenue attractiveness 100/100, decision banner "⚠ ESCALATE TO VP — Resolve Blockers Before Committing", animated SVG gauge, 12 clause-toggle cards (each showing severity badge, risk %, counter-position text, and financial consequence for all BLOCKERs), live recalculation on toggle, and "Show Worst-Case / Show Proposed Position" controls.
